title: Advertiser's Obligation to Discontinue or Modify Advertisement

content.scenario: A company in Mumbai is found to be airing a misleading advertisement for its new energy drink. The Central Authority, after investigation, orders the company to discontinue the advertisement within 15 days.
content.outcome: The company must discontinue the advertisement as directed by the Central Authority within the specified time frame of 15 days, as per the order, to avoid any further action.

user_queries: What happens if an advertisement is found to be misleading?
Can the Central Authority order an advertiser to discontinue an advertisement?
What are the consequences of not complying with the Central Authority's order?
